people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
translations.bsb: For this reason Christ died and returned to life, that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
translations.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
translations.asv: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
